# Official Khronos glTF validation fixtures

Unmodified source bytes from [glTF-Sample-Assets](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/c6a6bd13ab2b3c685c7903d03561b8a9392f38b8).
Exact source URLs, byte counts, hashes and per-model legal metadata are in [provenance.json](provenance.json). FORGE adds this index and test assertions; it does not alter the sample files.

These assets are test data, not FORGE engine art or branding. Preserve the listed attribution and supplied license/mark notices when redistributing. Logo usage remains within the original models; no endorsement or broader trademark license is implied.

Coverage: GLB and external glTF, textured PBR, normal maps, alpha modes, multiple primitives, skinning, node/morph animation, cameras, punctual lights, sparse accessors, mesh quantization, Draco, clearcoat, iridescence, sheen, transmission and anisotropy. These CPU import/cook checks are distinct from native rendered-image acceptance.
